spec.population: DB with >= 20 game backpedal plays (expected n ~82)
spec.feature_definition: Peak speed in the opening backpedal leg (t since motion onset in [0, L], L = 1.6 s BP90, 1.2 s TA2, 1.0 s W/BOX/BP45) of BACK_PEDAL_AND_90_DEGREE_BREAK_TO_BALL, TERYL_AUSTIN_DRILL_2, W_DRILL, BOX_DRILL, BACK_PEDAL_AND_TRANSITION_45_DEGREE_REACTION; z-scored within drill (clipped +-3), averaged over attempts within drill, then over drills (equal weight).
spec.target_definition: Per player-play: max speed over frames in [0, min(pass_forward, 2.5 s)] after the snap where vx > 0.5 yd/s (downfield) and orientation is within 60 deg of 270 (facing the LOS); plays with >= 5 such frames. Winsorized 1/99%, minus the mean of its lined_up_position x coverage_assignment cell, then empirical-Bayes shrunk player mean (normal-normal, method-of-moments tau2).
spec.feature_reliability_pre: cross-drill ICC of drill means (5 drills) -> reliability 0.55 (ICC per drill 0.20)
spec.target_reliability_pre: split-half by game (odd/even, Spearman-Brown, >= 10 plays per half): 0.85
spec.rationale: Backpedal speed is a technique skill scouts grade by eye; the stopwatch only measures forward speed. If drill backpedal speed predicts game backpedal speed beyond the 40/10-yd split, the drills carry information the timing tests miss.

spec.population: DB with >= 10 post-throw transitions out of the backpedal (expected n ~69)
spec.feature_definition: dv_10 = |v(t_min + 0.5 s) - v(t_min - 0.5 s)| (velocity-vector change across the plant, t_min = speed minimum of the detected break; segments.breaks min_turn 45, half_window 0.5, context 1.0) at the reversals of TERYL_AUSTIN_DRILL_1 (largest turn >= 90 deg, >= 1.5 s after onset), TERYL_AUSTIN_DRILL_2 (largest turn >= 120 deg, >= 1.5 s), W_DRILL (first 3 turns >= 90 deg), BOX_DRILL (first 2 turns >= 90 deg). Within each drill-cut: OLS residual on entry_speed and |turn|, z-scored (clipped +-3); averaged within drill, then over the 4 drills.
spec.target_definition: Breaks (segments.breaks, min_entry_speed 1.5) with speed minimum between 0.3 s after the snap and min(pass arrival, sack/scramble/tackle/out-of-bounds, 5 s), after pass_forward ('ball in air'), whose entry phase (0.8-0.3 s before the minimum) moves downfield (mean vx > 1) while facing the LOS (circular-mean orientation within 60 deg of 270). dv_10 winsorized 1/99%, OLS-residualized on |turn| (quadratic), entry speed, alignment (CB/SLOT_CB/HIGH_SAFETY/BOX_SAFETY) and man/zone/NA; empirical-Bayes shrunk player mean.
spec.feature_reliability_pre: cross-drill ICC of drill means (4 drills) -> 0.55; all 7 events as repeats -> 0.57
spec.target_reliability_pre: split-half by game (>= 5 events per half): 0.57
spec.rationale: 'Breaks on the ball': once the ball is thrown, how much velocity a DB changes through his plant out of the backpedal is the transition quickness coaches grade. The drill reversals isolate the same plant-and-drive under controlled conditions.

X1.description: drive (speed gained 0.5 s after plant), unadjusted Combine z

X2.description: peak re-acceleration out of the plant

X3.description: dv in PRE-throw transitions (game trait unreliable)

X5b.description: transition dv from W drill only
